intro: One pau kaya is about 200 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the flour-based bun and the sugar in the kaya filling.
diet: Yes. One pau kaya is small and works as a snack. But it's almost all carbs and sugar, so you get hungry again quickly. Pair it with some protein so you stay full longer.
tips: Have just 1 piece and pair it with a boiled egg.
Drink kopi or teh kosong, not a sweet drink.
Pick the mini size if available.

swap.name: 1 pau kaya + boiled egg
swap.why: The extra protein keeps you full longer than eating 2 paus.

faq.q: How long does pau kaya last?
faq.a: Frozen pau can last a few weeks. Once steamed, best to finish it within the day.

faq.q: How do I reheat pau without a steamer?
faq.a: Wrap it in a damp kitchen towel and microwave for 30 to 60 seconds.

faq.q: Can I give pau kaya to kids?
faq.a: Yes, as a snack, but not too often because it's high in sugar.
